Zoe: Kestrel wants a 1-day POC next Thurs. Requirements: 750 qps sustained, 3x short microbursts to 2.5k qps, p95/p99 targets and a hosted vs dedicated cost delta. Region: us-west-2.
Ravi: Noted. Model & tokens?
Zoe: 7B chat, avg prompt 30 tokens, avg response 600 tokens -> ~630 tokens per call.
Mei: Proposed run plan: 20m ramp to 750 qps, 1h steady, 3 bursts at 2.5k for 8s spaced 12m, then 15m cooldown. Collect p50/p95/p99, GPU util, queue depth, KV cache hit. Test fp16 and 4-bit quant.
Alex: Ops snippet to include:

```
--target-qps 750
--ramp 1200s
--steady 3600s
--burst "2500:8s x3"
--samples ./kestrel-samples.json
--metrics http://prometheus:9090
```

Ravi: Quick staging run (dedicated V100-equivalent, warm): fp16 steady 760 qps, p95=150ms, p99=320ms, KV-hit ~80%. Bursts cause p99 spikes to ~600ms before soft-eviction. Quant run: throughput ~1.9x but p99 increases ~1.4x.
Mei: Recommendation: Dedicated reserved for strict p99 SLAs. Use prefix KV cache + soft-eviction. If hosted, add 25% tail overhead.
Alex: Cost sketch: hosted per-token example $0.45/1k tokens -> per req ~0.284. Dedicated amortized estimate to sustain 750 qps with headroom ~$2.4k/day; multi-AZ active-active adds ~30% infra. I'll formalize numbers for the deck.
Zoe: Great. Can we review Tue 11am PT and send POC charter by EOD Wed?
